messages:
Carmen (Support): P1 - Sentinel Health trial users getting 403 during embedding calls after they onboarded new analysts. Customer demo scheduled tomorrow morning; they're threatening to pause evaluation if not resolved. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-8812

Carmen (Support): Logs show quota enforcement: 
```text
403 Forbidden - org quota exceeded
org_id: org-sentinel-21
active_sessions: 22
quota_limit: 12
```

Eli (CS): Looping @Ravi to coordinate an immediate unblock. I'll draft the customer note and lead the retention play. Options: short-term seat loan, console quota bump, or manual invoice hold release. Which is fastest?

Ravi (AM): Finance says the PO hit a credit hold for missing signatures; legal ETA ~36-48h. I can approve a 10-seat temporary loan (AM policy) if the customer signs a simple acknowledgement. I'll reach out to the customer now.

Tori (SRE): Quick operational option: temporary quota bump to 30 for 48h. Internal command: 
```bash
redwood-admin quota update --org org-sentinel-21 --limit 30 --ttl 48h --note "temp demo bump - AM approved pending PO"
```
This avoids creating billing churn and is reversible.

Eli (CS): Draft customer message: 
"Hi Nina, we want your demo to go smoothly. We can provision a temporary 10-seat boost or apply a 48-hour quota increase so your analysts can continue testing. This is temporary and will be reconciled once the PO completes. Reply 'Please proceed' to approve provisioning now. — Eli (Customer Success)"

Ravi (AM): Sending to customer and CCing finance. If no answer within 3 hours, I'll escalate to their procurement sponsor (per the high-touch playbook).

accounts-bot: Note: Temporary seat loans require AM approval and will create a prorated invoice. Billing task created: BILL-3347.

Carmen (Support): Attached HAR + repro steps in the ticket. Customer reports 14 blocked users during last session. Marking support action pending until provisioning is confirmed.

Tori (SRE): If customer agrees, I'll run the quota update and post job id. Prefer console bump if PO > 24h to avoid multiple manual adjustments.

Eli (CS): Action summary: 1) Ravi to get customer approval and AM sign-off. 2) If approved, Tori to apply 48h quota bump and post job id. 3) Ravi to flag renewal risk in Gainsight and schedule a 15m check-in post-demo. 4) Accounts to reconcile after PO completion. I'll update this thread with the customer's response.

Ravi (AM): Message sent. Copy of sent note: "Nina, we can provision a temporary 10-seat boost or a 48-hour quota increase to make the demo work. Approve by replying here and we'll provision immediately. - Ravi (AM)"

Carmen (Support): Thanks team. Please confirm here once the bump is live so I can close the support incident. :pray:
